desc: Implement state representation: encode a DP row d[0..N] (with d[0]=0, increments 0/1) as an N-bit mask where bit i means d[i+1] > d[i]; write encode/decode helpers.
Implement transition: given mask (current row) and a character c, compute the next LCS DP row against S in O(N) and return the new mask.
Precompute for each mask and each of 26 letters the resulting mask; group letters by resulting mask to get (next_mask, multiplicity) pairs per state.
Run the DP: dictionary/array mapping mask → count, iterate M steps applying grouped transitions modulo 998244353.
Aggregate results: for each mask, decode d[N] (popcount of mask) and add count into ans[popcount]; print ans[0..N].
Validate against the three samples (especially "aaa" case with repeated characters) and check complexity fits limits.
